def: Identifying the first pipeline stage at which a failed request went wrong, so the fix targets that stage.
The passage in the corpus that contains the answer to a test question, recorded so that retrieval and generation can be judged separately.
A failure in which the passage that holds the answer is not among the retrieved results at all.
A failure in which the answer-bearing passage is retrieved but ranked below the cut-off passed to the model, under worse passages.
A passage that looks relevant to the retriever, is ranked above the right one, and leads the model to a wrong answer.
A retrieved passage that is related to the question but does not contain the answer, and can pull the model away from it.
The state of an index containing superseded, changed or deleted information that the source of truth no longer holds.
A retrieval rule that keeps only chunks that have started, have not been superseded and are not drafts on the date being asked about.
A fluent, assured answer that the retrieved evidence does not support, produced when evidence is missing, weak or wrongly combined.
An evaluation that gives the generator only the gold passage, to measure the ceiling of the generation stage.
Placing the strongest retrieved passages at the start and end of the prompt and the weakest in the middle.
